text: Given a mocked vendor GET /api/apps/domains response with two domains, When msp360_list_domains is called, Then the response has count: 2, two domains entries each with exactly domain/storage/storage_limit/storage_usage_total/activated_licenses, and has_more: false.

Given a mocked vendor GET /api/apps/domains response with zero domains, When msp360_list_domains is called, Then the response is {"domains": [], "count": 0, "has_more": false} and not an error envelope.

Given the vendor login call (POST /api/Provider/Login) returns 401, When msp360_list_domains is called, Then the result is {"error": {"code": "unauthorized", "retryable": false, ...}} and the mocked GET /api/apps/domains client is never invoked.

Given the request to the MCP server is missing the X-Msp360-Username header, When msp360_list_domains is called, Then the server responds HTTP 401 listing the required headers, and no HTTP call to MSP360 is made.

Given two concurrent requests with different credentials (tenant A's mocked vendor response returns domain "acme.local", tenant B's returns domain "contoso.local"), When msp360_list_domains is called for each, Then tenant A's result contains only "acme.local" and tenant B's only "contoso.local", with no cross-tenant mixing.

Given a mocked vendor 200 login response containing a distinctive access_token value, When msp360_list_domains is called and its response body and all captured log output are searched for that exact string, Then the string is not found anywhere.
Given a mocked vendor response with 60 domains, When msp360_list_domains() is called with no arguments, Then exactly 50 are returned and has_more: true.
Given a mocked vendor response with 60 domains, When msp360_list_domains(limit=200) is called, Then all 60 are returned and has_more: false.
Given a mocked vendor response with 250 domains, When msp360_list_domains(limit=500) is called, Then at most 200 are returned (the hard cap wins over the requested limit) and has_more: true.

Given the GET /api/apps/domains call times out or returns a 5xx response, When msp360_list_domains is called, Then the result is {"error": {"code": "upstream_error", "retryable": true, ...}} and not an unhandled exception.
